neighbours.label: Memorised web/legal boilerplate at a fixed point: the cookie notice 'We use cookies ... to improve' (on ' improve') and the MIT licence line 'IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR' (on ' OR')
fire: Our website uses cookies to remember your settings and to improve your browsing experience.
We use cookies to analyse traffic on this site and to improve the service we offer.
This site uses cookies to operate correctly and to improve its content for readers.
We use cookies to personalise this website and to improve its usability over time.
By continuing you agree that we use cookies to run this shop and to improve its features.
We use cookies to keep this website secure and to improve its speed. Read our policy.

# LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
# OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
# SOFTWARE.

IN NO EVENT SHALL THE AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM, OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE SOFTWARE.
quiet: Our bakery uses butter to flavour the cookies and to improve their texture.
We use spreadsheets to track the orders and to improve the delivery times.
The school hired two tutors to help the pupils and to improve its exam results.
The town built a bypass to reduce traffic and to improve its air quality.
By training daily you agree to push yourself and to improve your stamina.
We use volunteers to keep the garden tidy and to improve its paths. Join us.

# PLEASE BRING A PEN OR PENCIL, A NOTEBOOK OR TABLET, AND
# A PACKED LUNCH OR SNACK FOR THE TRIP TO THE MUSEUM OR THE
# GALLERY.
ALL VISITORS MUST SIGN IN AT THE FRONT DESK OR THE SIDE GATE, AND MUST NOT ENTER THE WORKSHOP OR THE STORE ROOM WITHOUT A BADGE OR AN ESCORT.

notes: Card: 9 of the top 32 peaks are ' OR' in the MIT licence disclaimer and the top example is a cookie notice 'to improve its usability'; the rest are Arabic word pieces, which my two Arabic probes did not reproduce (0.05, 0.00). Probes: cookie notice 1.15, licence line 0.74, while 'to expand its factory and to upgrade its machines' gave 0.02, so it is not 'verb before its'. The label is a list of two boilerplates; the Arabic part of the pole is not covered.
